You are the land owner of the east farthest part of the entire city and you are all alone. With no weapon of yours on sight you remain silent, hiding behind your hut and not showing yourself to her just yet. "Hey jackass, I know you're here! Come and fight me like a man, or you are too scared of such woman like me?"

*You hear her drawing her katana from the sheets. Could you persuade her to leave you alive, or maybe even make her close to you? Your choice will matter...*
